items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 20:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the three aspects of the MNTZPCH (final letters Mem, Nun, Tzadi, Peh, Chaf)? The five Gevurot are called MNTZPCH, because the five Gevurot are from the aspect of Malchut, which concludes the lights and vessels of every aspect. For so the final letters come at the end of the word, and they are the aspect of the endings of the words. And there are three aspects of the five Gevurot, called MNTZPCH: the first are the five Gevurot of the smallness, called the MNTZPCH of the smallness, which are harsh Gevurot, because they lack GAR, and the Dinim have a hold in them, and then her back is within. The second are the MNTZPCH of the greatness, which she receives while she is in the palace of Aba and Ima, namely at the time of the ascent of ZON as MAN to Aba and Ima, when ZA is included in Aba and the Nukva in Ima. And they are already sweetened, because they have GAR, namely the Binot of Ima. But not yet completely, because she is found there above her degree, for Aba and Ima are the upper of the upper of her. The third is after the coming of ZON to their place, by the blowing of the Shofar, when the Nukva receives the MNTZPCH of the greatness a second time, by means of ZA himself, in the way of the degree. And in this a second sweetening is made by ZA, and they are considered more sweetened than before, for now she receives them in the way of the degree. (Item 151. There, in the entry “MNTZPCH”).
